issue.title: Reconcile sase/memory/generated_skills.md Uniform Agent Runtimes mismatch
issue.description: From land_conventional_commit_gate follow-up: generated_skills.md still describes runtime-specific availability for `sase_hg_commit`, contradicting Tier-1 Uniform Agent Runtimes semantics. Editing the memory note itself requires explicit user approval. Task is to update `sase/memory/generated_skills.md` to remove runtime-specific language and align docs with uniform runtime availability.

payload.close_reason: We should remove all references to /sase_hg_commit.

evidence.note: Verified after the 2026-07-31 close on SASE bb60a0bd1: sase memory read generated_skills.md still contains the 'Commit Skills per Runtime' table claiming /sase_hg_commit is Gemini-only and unavailable to Claude/Codex, directly contradicting the Tier-1 Uniform Agent Runtimes rule. The same table is also no longer an inventory of current provider runtimes (pyproject.toml registers agy, claude, codex, muse, opencode, and qwen). Discovered while evaluating generated-skill deployment for a Grok provider; the desired remediation remains removal of runtime-specific /sase_hg_commit guidance, as the closed task's reason says.

payload.entry: Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (requested by the project owner: keep the seven highest-impact open tasks, close the rest; master 443566f7d, workspace sase_13). Verified still live in-tree, and closed on priority rather than on staleness: sase-je (src/sase/ace/restore.py:220 still passes base_name positionally while 'sase stitch create --help' shows only [-n NAME], so sase restore still fails end to end -- cheap, well-scoped fix if you want it back) and sase-ca (sase memory read generated_skills.md still carries the 'Commit Skills per Runtime' table asserting /sase_hg_commit is Gemini-only, contradicting Tier-1 Uniform Agent Runtimes; editing a memory note needs explicit owner approval anyway, so this cannot be worked unattended). Closed as low-reach: sase-jv, sase-l5 (repo resolution from a numbered workspace), sase-kb (one commit's rebase conflict in the plans repo, worktree clean afterwards), sase-l0 (memory init --no-commit blast radius), sase-lq (Grok Build double-loads AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md -- duplicate instructions, not wrong ones), sase-lp (a ~2h one-shot migration that has already been run). sase-ks is additionally superseded in substance: commit 9df15dbe2 made LaunchSelection the single consuming boundary for pooled aliases and reconciles root agent_meta.json, prompt_step_*.json, and chat metadata against the model actually invoked. Re-file any of these with a +1 if it bites during real work.

payload.close_reason: Deprioritized in the 2026-08-14 task-backlog triage: single-surface CLI/doc papercuts with narrow blast radius, closed in favor of cross-agent correctness and gate-blocking work.
